findings: Winning rule is 'full-row': tau=0.10 (text nearly off) + date-overlap gate + field-agreement>=0.5; location gate OFF.
Biggest gains came from LOWERING the text-similarity floor, not raising it (iter1 +0.358, iter5 +0.122): true dups are low-sim; structured agreement carries the signal.
Strict location matching HURT (iter3 -0.014): location drift loses true-dup recall without removing FPs.
Residual 15 FP are same-day field-agreeing flap pairs that programmatic gates cannot separate -> the LLM/semantic Tier-3 confirmer's job, as designed.
Gold set is small (45 pos / 51 neg, 96 pairs); numbers are directional. Grow labels over the UNKNOWN band to harden the operating point.

Embedding confirmer (MiniLM) did NOT beat the structured method: iter10 (embed_tau0.78)=0.764, iter11 (0.45)=0.796 < 0.8119. Residual FPs are flap pairs that are semantically similar (neg embed_sim up to 0.95), so no similarity metric separates them — only the LLM Tier-3 does.

APPLIED to full Excel: 35,778 candidate pairs → 2,613 programmatic flags (flap over-merge) → 318 high-confidence (embed≥0.85+gates) → 303 LLM-confirmed → 232 duplicate clusters, 274 redundant rows (15.3% of dataset). Output: PURSUE_1_2_3_dedup_flagged.xlsx (nothing deleted; canonical row flagged per cluster).
